_why: 6a-prime was the only `exec agy` path whose deliverable rode the agent's last message alone; four dispatches read the tree and were discarded for the last line. Each mutation carries its own `test` key.

mutations.name: the-report-file-is-never-preferred
mutations._mechanism: The channel is built and then unused — indistinguishable from never having built it, and the last message stays the only surface.
mutations.find:
if report_text is not None:
        review = report_text

mutations.name: an-empty-report-file-is-authoritative
mutations._mechanism: An agent that creates the file and writes nothing is the commonest partial failure. Treating empty as authoritative turns a recoverable verdict in the last message into NO_VERDICT.

mutations.name: the-fallback-claims-the-file-channel
mutations._mechanism: A verdict recovered from the last message and one read from the file are different evidence. Printing the same channel for both makes the fallback silent, which is the defect one level down.

mutations.name: the-channel-is-not-reported-at-all
mutations._mechanism: Without it a reader cannot tell which surface carried the verdict, and the whole point of the change becomes unobservable.

mutations.name: the-slot-leaves-the-shipped-template
mutations._mechanism: The machinery is worthless if the real template never tells the agent where to write.

mutations.name: the-slot-is-substituted-unconditionally
mutations._mechanism: Back-compat: a caller staging a pre-slot template with no --report-file would get the literal string None pasted in, or MISSING_SLOTS on a template that never asked for it.
mutations.find:
if report_file is not None:
        pairs = pairs + (("<INLINE_REPORT_FILE>", report_file),)
